content: To be wealthy and honored in an unjust society is a disgrace.
author: Confucius
explanation: Confucius establishes that material prosperity achieved by compromising moral integrity or colluding with corrupt power degrades human worth. Moral dignity must always supersede social prestige.
practicalInsight: Evaluate your professional pursuits by their ethical foundation rather than mere financial expediency.
reflectionPrompt: Are there any compromises with integrity you are tempted to make in exchange for external reward?
